title: Product Lead, Finance Accounting
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the Team**

The Finance Accounting team builds the accounting foundation behind Rippling’s Finance products. We help customers turn the activity happening across spend, procurement, reimbursements, and other finance workflows into accurate, auditable data in their ERP.

This is a high-leverage product area where accounting infrastructure, ERP connectivity, and AI automation meet. The team’s work spans the full lifecycle of financial data: helping customers configure accounting rules, validate transactions before they post, recover when syncs fail, and ultimately close their books with more confidence and less manual work.

**About the role**

We’re looking for a Product Lead to lead Finance Accounting at Rippling. You will own the accountant experience across Rippling’s Finance products and help define the future of accounting automation on top of Rippling’s platform.

Your mandate spans two important problems. First, you will build the accounting infrastructure, workflows, and ERP integrations required for Rippling to serve complex enterprise Finance customers. Second, you will help create a new generation of AI-powered accounting workflows that automate manual close work — from validating transaction coding and configuration readiness, to recovering failed syncs, reconciling activity, and preparing adjustments.

Rippling sits in a unique position between the systems where business activity originates and the ERP where the official books live. That gives us the context to automate work accountants perform manually today and to build an accounting product that can become a major platform in its own right.

**What you will do**

* Set the product strategy and roadmap for Finance Accounting, with a clear point of view on how Rippling should help finance teams translate their operational activity in Rippling into accurate accounting outcomes.
* Build the core accounting platform behind Rippling’s Finance products, including the workflows customers use to configure rules, map data, post to their ERP, and resolve issues when syncs fail.
* Design product experiences that give accountants confidence in the accuracy, completeness, and auditability of their books.
* Lead the development of AI-assisted accounting workflows that help customers validate transactions, identify exceptions, recover from failures, and reduce manual close work.
* Partner deeply with engineering and design to turn complex accounting and integration problems into intuitive, reliable product experiences.
* Spend time with customers, implementation teams, support, accounting experts, and ERP partners to understand where accounting workflows break down and where the product can remove friction.
* Define how Rippling should support enterprise customers and their unique needs, like multi-entity setups, tax and currency needs, and high expectations for controls and reporting.

**What you will need**

* 7+ years of product management experience, ideally working on complex B2B software.
* Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into a clear strategy.
* Experience building technically complex products that depend on integrations, data models, or platform infrastructure.
* A strong understanding of accounting workflows and the financial systems businesses use to run them, or the ability to quickly develop fluency in them.
* The ability to work closely with engineers on complex system and data problems.
* Strong customer instincts and a willingness to learn detailed accounting workflows firsthand.
* High ownership. You should be comfortable setting direction and making decisions in a fast-moving environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

If you don’t meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. Skills and experiences can show up in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and backgrounds.

**Nice to have**

* Experience building accounting, ERP, fintech, or financial operations products.
* Familiarity with systems such as NetSuite, QuickBooks, Sage Intacct, or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Experience with month-end close, reconciliation, transaction coding, or financial integrations.
* Experience building AI agents or AI-powered workflow products.
* Experience building products for controllers, accountants, or enterprise finance teams.

JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Role summary
  
The Finance Analyst will support the Client Account Finance Manager with all areas of the finance function of the account, including month-end reporting, budgeting and forecasting, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting for the Client, Account Management team and to the JLL Corporate Finance Team.
  
Responsibilities
  
Preparation of invoices and supporting documentation to Clients.
  
Managing and continually improve the invoicing process and ensuring that all revenues are correctly reported on a monthly basis.
  
Manage and monitor project budgets and financials;
  
Ensuring that all expenses and accruals are recorded accurately to timetable on a monthly basis.
  
Ensuring that the monthly results for the Business Units are accurately reflected into the Client reporting tools, including JDE.
  
Support monthly reporting process by ensuring that the monthly result is reported accurately and to timetable.
  
  
**CLIENT FACING:**  
Ensure and support delivery of all Client and JLL financials related to the client contract;
  
Develop and implement Client reporting tools;
  
Client liaison; build strong collaborative partnership with client project managers;
  
Supporting the client side finance teams with any queries/information requests.
  
Identify and initiate necessary change control processes;
  
Co-ordinate communications with all project stakeholders regarding status, progress and issues relating to the project;
  
Maintain project schedule data, cost data & performance indicator data in online integrated IT system;
  
Provide expert advice to local Facilities Managers
  
Ad hoc duties as required
  
  
**Additional Duties and Responsibilities:**  
Assist wider client team in developing and enhancing the client delivery platform.
  
Monitor compliance to relevant policies and procedures – make recommendations to ensure procedures are maintained, up to date and reflect ongoing project delivery needs.
  
Key Performance Measures
  
Performance Review Agreements, mid-year and year end
  
Positive impact on client KPI scores.
  
Positive client feedback received.
  
Requirements
  
4-5 years’ experience in a similar position (working with international teams and clients).
  
Motivated, positive and flexible in approach to work and able to develop others in such an approach.
  
Proactive in identifying issues and potential solutions.
  
Self – supporting; diligent; can deliver to tight deadlines.
  
Ability to learn quickly, and desire to develop.
  
Ability to work collaboratively and through challenges with the client; other members of the account and corporate teams.
  
**Customer Service:** Commitment to solve requests and problems.
  
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  
Excellent PC skills, proficient in Office tools, especially Microsoft Outlook Excel, Power Point VBA & Macros
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Senior Finance Operations Analyst
description:
**About Us**

Finmo is a next-generation Treasury Operating System that enables CFOs to see their financial operations in real time and forecast what's coming next. It unifies payments, cash and liquidity management, FX risk management, and financial reporting into a single intelligent platform, transforming fragmented data into connected, actionable intelligence.  
  
Finmo is backed by leading fintech investors. Our oversubscribed US$18.5M Series A was co-led by PayPal Ventures and Quona Capital, with participation from Citi Ventures, bringing total funding to US$27M. We are also recognised by respected industry institutions, including:

  

* CB Insights Fintech 100 (2025) - named among the 100 most promising private fintech companies
* Forbes Asia 100 to Watch (2025)
* Grand Award – Cross-Border Fintech Unicorn Potential (2026) by Asia FinTech Alliance
* FinTech of the Year (2026) by Asia FinTech Awards

Founded in 2021, Finmo is headquartered in Singapore, with additional offices in Australia, Malaysia, and India, and plans for further global expansion. We are committed to upholding core values such as curiosity, integrity, attitude and customer-centricity. We foster a culture that encourages thoughtful risk-taking and problem-solving, aiming to balance perfection with timely execution

For more information, please visit our website at www.finmo.net

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Senior Finance Operations Specialist to join our team. This role will be responsible for ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of financial processes, including fund movements, account reconciliations, and reporting. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, experience with multi-currency transactions, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Settlements**

* Act as the primary point of contact for resolving settlement and invoicing-related issues, ensuring timely and accurate payments.
* Manage fund movements across banking partners and multiple currencies, ensuring adherence to cut-off times and SLAs.
* Monitor currency cut-offs and settlement timelines to prevent delays.
* Track and manage liquidity positions with banking partners to ensure uninterrupted operations.

**Reconciliation**

* Perform daily bank reconciliations across multiple entities to ensure accuracy andcompleteness.
* Reconcile incoming and outgoing payments by matching bank statements with internal system ledgers across multiple banks and currencies.
* Identify, investigate, and resolve unmatched, delayed, or failed transactions in a timely manner.
* Maintain detailed reconciliation logs, exception reports, and obtain required managerial approvals in line with internal controls and compliance requirements.

**Payment Operations**

* Own and manage payment operations inquiries, coordinating effectively with internal teams, partners, and clients to ensure timely resolution.
* Ensure sufficient operational coverage to meet Service Level Agreements (SLAs) across all financial operations activities.
* Lead and execute FinOps initiatives and process improvement projects to enhance efficiency, scalability, and risk control.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of experience in Financial Operations, Payments, FinOps, Reconciliation, or a related role.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify and resolve issues independently.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to liaise effectively between internal teams and external banking partners.
* Experience working with financial reporting systems and working alongside technology teams for process improvements.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple tasks with tight deadlines.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work in a high-growth fintech environment.
* Cross-functional learning in risk management and compliance operations.
* Competitive compensation and growth opportunities.

title: Risk Analyst II, Account Integrity
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's Account Integrity Team (AIT) within Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) protects hundreds of millions of customers by identifying and stopping fraudulent activity before it causes harm. The Risk Mining function is where human ingenuity meets machine learning - our team detects emerging modus operandi (MOs) that automated systems alone can't catch, and feeds those signals back into scalable upstream defenses. Nowhere is that fight sharper than in Anti-Automation, where we go head-to-head with bots, scripted attacks, and automated abuse that evolves by the hour. If you want to do investigative work that directly translates into customer trust at global scale, this is the role.  
  
The Risk Analyst II (Risk Mining) is a senior individual-contributor role that sits at the intersection of three disciplines - analyst, strategist, and ML partner. You will join the Anti-Automation Risk Mining team in India - a team of analysts, investigators, and builders who hunt down automated abuse before it scales. As the analyst, you run deep dives on bot and scripted-attack behavior and turn raw signal into high-quality MO documentation. As the strategist, you shape where the vertical invests its detection effort and anticipate how the adversary will evolve. As the ML partner, you work hand-in-hand with Machine Learning and Engineering to convert your findings into scalable, automated upstream defenses and close the feedback loop into models and rules.  
  
This is a hands-on, high-ownership role with broad cross-team influence, reporting to Risk Mining leadership. You are accountable for the quality, speed, and impact of your investigations - detecting automated MOs, driving measurable gains in detection speed and precision, mitigating risk, and clearing the blockers that stand between the team and impact. As a senior IC, you are expected to raise the bar for investigation quality across the vertical and influence detection strategy well beyond your own caseload.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
- Lead complex investigations into emerging automated abuse - running deep dives on bots, scripted attacks, and automated MOs before they scale, and setting the quality bar others follow.  
- Own detection and mitigation strategy for the Anti-Automation vertical - prioritizing the highest-risk automated MOs and anticipating how bots and scripted attacks will evolve.  

* Partner deeply with Machine Learning and Engineering teams to turn your findings into scalable, automated upstream defenses, and own the feedback loop back into models and rules.

- Translate investigative signal into ML features, detection logic, and rule improvements - acting as the bridge between front-line investigation and automated defense.  

* Produce high-quality deep dives, MO write-ups, and analyses, and own vertical-level metrics for detection volume, speed, and precision.
* Collaborate with the other Risk Mining verticals and partner teams (Payment Risk, Abuse Risk Mining) on joint investigations and shared signals.
* Serve as a subject-matter expert on high-severity incidents and escalations.
* Champion automation and GenAI opportunities to amplify throughput and quality, and measure the realized ROI from those investments.

  
A day in the life  
No two days look the same when the automated-abuse landscape shifts in real time - your week balances hands-on investigation, strategy, and close ML partnership to keep Anti-Automation ahead of emerging threats:  
  
Analyst (Investigation & Analysis)  

* Running deep dives on the highest-risk automated MOs and following the signal in the noise and take mitigation action.
* Pulling and analyzing large datasets to size impact, confirm hypotheses, and sharpen detection.
* Documenting findings and MO write-ups so they can be turned into durable, scalable defenses.

  
Strategy (Building What's Next)  
- Shaping the detection and mitigation strategy for your slice of Risk Mining - anticipating how automated abuse will evolve and positioning the team to stay ahead.  

* Championing GenAI and automation opportunities as a core part of the vertical's strategy.

  
ML Partnership (Scaling the Defense)  

* Partnering with ML and Engineering to turn your findings into automated defenses that scale.
* Translating investigative signal into features, detection logic, and rule improvements.
* Owning the feedback loop so model and rule performance keeps improving on the MOs you surface.

  
Tactical (Keeping the Engine Running)  

* Reporting detection metrics and progress on key goals.
* Responding to live escalations when a new automated attack surfaces.

  
About the team  
The Risk Mining team within Account Integrity spans India, US, and Costa Rica, and works for Amazon's worldwide marketplace to detect and disrupt bad-actor behavior.  
  
Our mission is simple: find the signal in the noise before bad actors cause harm. We operate across three risk verticals - Anti-Automation, Account Takeover, and Bad Actor Account - and partner closely with Machine Learning, Engineering, and Product teams to turn our investigative findings into scalable upstream defenses. The Anti-Automation vertical sits at the front line of that fight, taking on bots and scripted abuse at the scale.
